entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, OSS SDK, or managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine provides sub-300ms recall for Hermes Agents using a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while integrating with external data sources like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Serving as an opinionated brain for Hermes Agents, this project features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to synthesize answers with citations. It is designed for multi-user team environments through the use of scoped access controls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and supports Python, Node.js, Go, and CLI clients for both hosted and self-hosted deployments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library enables stateful agents through a FastAPI server that supports hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers and provides both Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider treats memory as a git repository with versioning features like commit, branch, and merge. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI for managing markdown context trees.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that delivers sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a dedicated Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and includes an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness improves agent performance on complex tasks through outcome-gated promotion of context bundles and playbooks. It integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints via Python and TypeScript implementations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a SQLite-backed message store with full-text search metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing messages.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agents by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from platforms like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores data locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and local embedders to integrate with tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without the need for API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, to provide memory through MCP and agent plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by using block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. This approach reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% in tokens for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a reason for its selection. It supports embedded in-process operation and includes features for contradiction tracking and owner-scoping in multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn offers cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes codebases and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, rendering them into files like AGENTS.md. It includes a Rust-based MCP server for persistent semantic memory and aims to reduce prompt tokens by 94%.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool keywords. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, real event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering dedicated tools for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates an autonomous payment model where APIs can charge for services and agents can pay for themselves directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing by routing questions to entire artifacts instead of using standard chunk-based RAG. It registers five native tools for knowledge retrieval and supports automated tool-routing note generation through model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents with support for manual memory storage. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and offers flexible execution via Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods to manage long-term agent data.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin serves as a private local memory for code repositories, enabling semantic and literal searches over localhost. It supports grounded Q&A by providing specific file-and-line citations for its responses.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to enable autonomous task execution for Hermes Agent. It enforces rigorous software engineering standards, including red-green-refactor TDD and YAGNI principles, across multiple coding harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first prototyping system that provides Hermes Agent with a CLI for generating web, mobile, and desktop designs. It supports application development on macOS and Windows, bridging the gap between design specs and agentic coding.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library equips agents with 817 structured security skills mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It spans 29 security domains and maintains compatibility across more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across different sessions. It processes various data formats into a graph structure and offers dedicated clients for Rust and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables Hermes Agent to transform natural language descriptions and Mermaid text into editable .drawio files. It features 11 diagram presets and includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates escrow and dispute resolution services to facilitate secure financial transactions between autonomous agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table. It is specifically designed for compatibility with Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor environments.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses an Agentic Evolver to automate skill deduplication and quality improvements across team environments. It synchronizes skill libraries across multiple devices and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 12 metaskills that allow agents to preserve state within a local directory. These skills are delivered as spec-conformant plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compliant systems.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,117 task-specific markdown files designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides a vast library of 822 professional skills with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants like Gemini and ChatGPT.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows Hermes Agent to extract transcripts, search results, and channel data directly from YouTube. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with various coding environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing agents to self-expand their capabilities via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific domains. It enhances critical output by reporting findings alongside an assessment of potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for Pydantic AI through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. The workflow features Lite and Full modes for varying complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs code edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory backed by files or SQLite. It facilitates cross-feature learning and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards through a plan-approve-execute cycle.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin establishes cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It creates a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable direct interaction with Chainlink services like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. They provide specialized capabilities for integrating oracle networks and smart contracts into agent workflows.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources in Portuguese. All skills are delivered in the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. The repository also includes a specialized suite of six skills for FLUX 3 video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It supports Node.js and Python environments while providing provenance through file and line number citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, as well as commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language that audits AI intents for cost, permissions, and types before execution. It generates verifiable, hash-chained receipts for every run and supports local execution via Ollama.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for secure HTTPS communication using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval skill uses a five-layer system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It reduces token overhead and features graceful degradation if specific embedding dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool performs adversarial code reviews using three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and exploitability. It combines deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep with sandbox execution to verify or refute findings.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: An ADHD-friendly execution system where an AI agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores data locally using SQLite and connects to agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like Discord and CLI to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A code simplification skill that utilizes parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It supports multiple languages including Rust and Python, featuring a tiered application process with a final approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatic skill directory registration.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A comprehensive cybersecurity lab providing over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven tasks.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and offers a public API for skill submission and verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and creating boards, with 85% of the payment automatically routed to the winning wallet upon human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator for Hermes Agent produces structured reports across geographic scales ranging from global to street level. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides utilities for video-to-text transcription, local OCR for PDFs and images, and batch e-commerce material generation. It also includes a specialized tool for removing 'AI flavor' from generated text to improve copy quality.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures compatibility by verifying existing interpreters and routing file operations using environment-specific syntax.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills through a hosted MCP server. The project provides structured web data access across 31 platforms for clients including Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Provides a one-line command to install Hermes Agent via Termux on Android devices. The setup supports over 200 AI models and includes a gateway service for incoming connections.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: A one-command installer that enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH). It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. This setup provides kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: Provides a simple Docker sandbox image containing the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for specific Hermes tag builds using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane designed to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances through a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities while providing hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready, headless systemd deployment for Ubuntu and Debian servers. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: A portable production package that runs from a USB or drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to deploy specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks. It features a researcher team that assesses insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other frameworks through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, scheduling, and monitoring spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web dashboard for managing parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It utilizes git worktrees for management and offers optional Docker or Podman sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture governed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes and other coding agents. It runs entirely on local hardware across Windows, macOS, and Linux, featuring an auto-sync capability to keep the index current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard that tracks token usage and associated costs for multiple AI coding agents including Hermes and Claude Code. It allows developers to monitor consumption data across various clients to manage expenses effectively.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from coding agents like Hermes, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions and automatically redacts common authentication headers to protect sensitive credentials.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, supporting any provider that utilizes markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 30 other AI coding tools. It features multi-device synchronization and displays historical usage trends to help developers track performance over time.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. Using YAML-based configurations, developers can modify banner colors and spinners to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing agent workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by the agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using USDC and SOL on the Solana blockchain.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities for platforms like Telegram and Slack using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents by applying per-folder configurations, skills, and project-local memories. It allows users to switch seamlessly between default and scoped agents while maintaining custom instructions specific to individual directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installation tool deploys a complete hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services in minutes at zero cost. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories for rapid environment setup.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed for AI agent configurations and system prompts, utilizing HERM v1.1 scoring to identify issues like unbounded retries or conflicting output formats. It performs deterministic local checks and exports results in SARIF 2.1.0 or JSON formats to ensure configuration integrity.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes config-aware baselines by tracking local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with wake word support and no required API keys. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with the Tauri 2 framework that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It manages configurations for Hermes Agent alongside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs. It supports remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram, and includes assistants for generating editable PPT, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface that runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations and models. It features a three-panel layout with an integrated workspace file browser and is accessible via browser or mobile through secure SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for chat, sessions, and tools, and supports multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard that provides multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It features streaming responses, tool traces, visual workflow building, Kanban boards, and channel configuration for 10 platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It includes a full workspace file browser with Monaco and PTY terminal, and supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode as a desktop or self-hosted app. It allows users to delegate tasks to sub-agents using @ mentions and can run unattended tasks on separate git branches.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via direct local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, along with an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop app built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that also supports macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution and features a UI for MCP tools, memory management, and LaTeX/Mermaid rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser context to a local, Hermes Cloud, or remote API Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Web for full-page session management and site-aware drafting via Hermes Assist.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage agent sessions, tasks, and skills, while providing read-only access to memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw engines. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports 13 agent sources, including Hermes. It features image browsing, analytics, and one-click resume functionality for supported CLIs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: A TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It allows for real-time tracking of session activity and costs, as well as read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming. It includes a marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client for orchestrating collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
